subject: general
question:
In this question, a statement is followed by two courses of action, numbered I and II. You must assume everything in the statement to be true and on the basis of the information given in the statement, decide which of the courses of action logically follow(s) for pursuing.

Statement: The river running through Town A is heavily polluted, affecting aquatic life and posing risks to public health due to industrial waste disposal and untreated sewage.

Courses of Action:

I. Invest in building advanced wastewater treatment plants to treat industrial effluents and sewage before releasing them into the river.

II. Launch a community-led initiative to organise regular river clean up drives involving volunteers from Town A.
